tools.name: botpress_get_account
tools.description: Show the Botpress account that owns the token (id, email, display name). Admin API: GET /v1/admin/account/me.

tools.name: botpress_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces the token's user can access, with plan, bot count and spending limit. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/workspaces.

tools.name: botpress_list_workspace_members
tools.description: List the members of the connected workspace with their role and email. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/workspace-members.

tools.name: botpress_list_bots
tools.description: List the bots of the connected workspace (id, name, type, deploy time). Good first call: the other tools need a bot id. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/bots.

tools.name: botpress_get_bot
tools.description: Get one bot: name, type, deploy time, tags and the enabled state of its integrations. The signing secret and integration configuration are left out on purpose. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/bots/{id}.

tools.name: botpress_get_bot_logs
tools.description: Read the logs of a bot in a time range, with filters for level, user, conversation and message text. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/bots/{id}/logs.

tools.name: botpress_get_bot_analytics
tools.description: Get usage analytics of a bot per period: users, sessions, messages, events and LLM calls, tokens and cost. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/bots/{id}/analytics.

tools.name: botpress_list_bot_issues
tools.description: List the grouped runtime issues (errors) of a bot with counts and last-seen time. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/bots/{id}/issues.

tools.name: botpress_list_conversations
tools.description: List the conversations of a bot, with channel, integration and message count. Filter by date, channel or participant. Runtime API: GET /v1/chat/conversations.

tools.name: botpress_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation of a bot by id. Runtime API: GET /v1/chat/conversations/{id}.

tools.name: botpress_list_messages
tools.description: List the messages of a bot, for one conversation or for a date range. Runtime API: GET /v1/chat/messages.

tools.name: botpress_list_users
tools.description: List the end users who talked to a bot. Filter by conversation or date. Runtime API: GET /v1/chat/users.

tools.name: botpress_get_user
tools.description: Get one end user of a bot by id. Runtime API: GET /v1/chat/users/{id}.

tools.name: botpress_list_tables
tools.description: List the Tables of a bot with their schema. Tables API: GET /v1/tables.

tools.name: botpress_get_table
tools.description: Get one Table with its schema, row count and indexing state. Tables API: GET /v1/tables/{table}.

tools.name: botpress_find_table_rows
tools.description: Read rows of a Table with an optional MongoDB-like filter, text search, column selection and sorting. Read only. Tables API: POST /v1/tables/{table}/rows/find.

tools.name: botpress_list_files
tools.description: List the files in the knowledge base of a bot (key, size, type, indexing status). Files API: GET /v1/files.

tools.name: botpress_get_file
tools.description: Get the metadata of one file of a bot, by id or key. Files API: GET /v1/files/{id}.

tools.name: botpress_search_files
tools.description: Semantic search over the indexed files of a bot. Returns the best matching text passages. Files API: GET /v1/files/search.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "botpress_get_bot" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get one bot: name, type, deploy time, tags and the enabled state of its integrations. The signing secret and integration configuration are left out on purpose. …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: botpress_get_account, botpress_list_workspace_members, botpress_get_bot_logs, botpress_get_bot_analytics, botpress_list_bot_issues, botpress_list_conversations, botpress_get_conversation, botpress_list_messages, botpress_list_users, botpress_get_user, botpress_find_table_rows · Private data: botpress_get_account, botpress_list_workspaces, botpress_get_bot, botpress_get_bot_analytics, botpress_list_files, botpress_get_file, botpress_search_files · Public sink: botpress_get_account, botpress_list_workspace_members, botpress_find_table_rows.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: botpress_get_account, botpress_list_workspace_members, botpress_get_bot_logs, botpress_get_bot_analytics, botpress_list_bot_issues, botpress_list_conversations, botpress_get_conversation, botpress_list_messages, botpress_list_users, botpress_get_user, botpress_find_table_rows · Private data: botpress_get_account, botpress_list_workspaces, botpress_get_bot, botpress_get_bot_analytics, botpress_list_files, botpress_get_file, botpress_search_files · Public sink: botpress_get_account, botpress_list_workspace_members, botpress_find_table_rows

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
